parameters.name: CallCenterNumber
parameters.description:
The phone number used by the Back to Back Agent.

This phone number must belong to the call center instance specified by **instanceId**. If this parameter is not specified, a random number available for outbound calls is selected from the specified instance.

parameters.name: Callee
parameters.description: The phone number of the callee.

parameters.name: Caller
parameters.description: The phone number of the caller.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The call center instance ID.

The phone number used by the Back to Back Agent must belong to this call center instance.

parameters.name: WorkflowId
parameters.description:
The ID of the contact flow.

This contact flow is used to assist in establishing the two-party call. This field is reserved for future use. Leave it empty.
